Bitcoin was four years old. Crypto was still a fringe idea and the banks were not listening yet.

He said Ripple was built as a payment system first. 💳

The currency exists to support the network and not the other way around🎯

“We think it could be the biggest game changer in finance since the internet was created.”🌐

His test for a new currency came down to three things: Trust. Utility. Liquidity.✅

Listen closely.📝👇
